# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_VOLUME_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a midday volatility contraction, a breakout of the prior 30‑minute range with expanding volume signals a continuation move. The edge exists because volatility compression often precedes institutional participation, and a volume‑expanding breakout captures the ensuing directional impulse before mean‑reversion algorithms can react.

## Mechanism

Between 11:30 and 13:00 ET, compute the 30‑minute range high/low from the open to the current bar. If price breaks above the range high on a bar where volume > 1.3× the average 5‑minute volume of the prior 20 bars, enter long at the bar's close. Exit: chart‑stop at the 30‑minute range low, TP1 at 1.5R (risk = entry – stop), and a runner that trails 15% off the high‑water mark. Regime filter: only consider entries when ATR(20) < 0.5×ATR(50) AND VIX < 20.
